japan.basis: lyricist 高野辰之 (1947); composer 岡野貞一 (1941). The later of the two deaths is 1947.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.basis: first published 1914, 尋常小学唱歌 第六学年用.
us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

_licence.verses_permitted_note: The report transcribes the first verse only, so this file carries one verse. More verses need a fresh trip to the source, not a memory.
_licence.note: Derived from data/songs/oborozukiyo.json: one item per line, the pieces cut on the word boundaries of the corpus's romaji line aligned onto the kana (a one-kana piece joins the piece before it, a repeated piece is one piece), the verse gloss shown after a miss. Verdicts, credits and the authors' death years are copied from that file.

items.line: なの はな ばたけに いりひ うすれ

gloss.en: The setting sun dims over the rape-blossom field, haze lies deep on the ridge; look at the sky the spring breeze stirs, and a faint evening moon is hanging there.
